corrected_samples.question: Jamal is rolling a d12 die. How much more likely is it (expressed as a percentage) that he rolls a number greater than 6 than that he rolls four odd numbers in a row?
corrected_samples.expected_answer:
There are 6 numbers greater than 6 on the dice, so the chances of rolling one of them are 6 / 12 = 50%.
The chance of rolling one odd number is 50%, so the chance of rolling four in a row is 50% * 50% * 50% * 50% = 6.25%.
The difference between these two probabilities is 50% - 6.25% = 43.75%.
#### 43.75
corrected_samples.original_model_answer:
要确定Jamal掷出一个大于6的数字的可能性，我们可以通过考虑12面骰子上可能的结果来计算这种情况的概率。由于大于6的数字有6个（7、8、9、10、11、12），因此掷出这些数字其中一个的概率是：
\[ P(>6) = \frac{6}{12} = \frac{1}{2} \]

要计算Jamal连续掷出4个奇数的概率，我们首先求出他掷出一个奇数的概率。由于骰子上有6个奇数（1、3、5、7、9、11），因此掷出这些数字中的一个的概率是：
\[ P(\text{奇数}) = \frac{6}{12} = \frac{1}{2} \]

由于连续4次掷骰子是一系列独立事件，掷出四个连续奇数的概率是掷出一个奇数的概率的4次方：
\[ P(4 \text{ 奇数}) = \left( \frac{1}{2} \right)^4 = \frac{1}{16} \]

现在，要确定掷出大于6的数字的概率比连续四次掷出奇数的概率高出多少百分比，我们可以通过比较两个概率来计算百分比差：
\[ \text{百分比差} = \left( \frac{P(>6) - P(4 \text{ 奇数})}{P(4 \text{ 奇数})} \right) \times 100\% \]
\[ \text{百分比差} = \left( \frac{\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{16}}{\frac{1}{16}} \right) \times 100\% \]
\[ \text{百分比差} = \left( \frac{\frac{8}{16} - \frac{1}{16}}{\frac{1}{16}} \right) \times 100\% \]
\[ \text{百分比差} = \left( \frac{\frac{7}{16}}{\frac{1}{16}} \right) \times 100\% \]
\[ \text{百分比差} = 7 \times 100\% \]
\[ \text{百分比差} = 700\% \]

这意味着掷出一个大于6的数字的可能性比连续掷出四个奇数的可能性大700%。

\[ \text{Difference} = 75\% - 6.25\% = 68.75\% \]

To express this difference as a percentage more likely, considering the baseline of rolling four odd numbers (6.25%), we calculate:

\[ \text{Percentage more likely} = \left( \frac{68.75\%}{6.25\%} \right) \times 100\% \]
